blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Visual proxies decouple explicit world-state simulation from photorealistic video synthesis, offering a controllable interface for both offline clip creation and real-time interactive streaming. Yet a practical renderer must address two challenges. Upstream proxies vary from coarse layouts to fine articulated geometry depending on the interaction, and streaming inference must operate in a few causal steps without accumulating drift across self-generated history. We present Invoker-Render, pairing a bidirectional creation model with a causal four-step streaming model under a shared conditioning interface over structural proxies, an appearance reference, and language. Trained on an aligned approximately 200-hour multi-granularity corpus, Invoker-Render honors fine geometric constraints when supplied while synthesizing plausible local motion under coarse proxies, enabling runtime selection of input detail. To bridge bidirectional creation and real-time streaming without compounding step compression and rollout drift, we introduce Progressive Forcing (ProForcing). ProForcing first trains a causal predictor and distills it into a four-step renderer using histories derived from training videos. Training then shifts to continuous self-generated rollouts. A pipelined serving stack supports efficient streaming inference. Experiments show versatile control across proxy families, granularities, and camera paths, consistent gains over recent streaming baselines, and stable 30-minute racing rollouts that preserve scene and subject appearance.
blocks.zh: 视觉代理将清晰的世界状态模拟从光现实主义视频合成中解析出,为离线剪辑的创建和实时互动流提供可控界面. 然而,一个实际的表述者必须应对两个挑战。 上游代词因相互作用的不同而异,从粗糙的布局到细细的分明几何,而流入推论必须运行在几个因果步骤上,而不会累积跨越自生历史的漂移. 我们提出Invoker-Render, 将双向创建模型与一个因果四步相接的相接模式在结构代词的共享条件界面下对齐, 一个外观参考,以及语言. Invoker-Render对大约200小时的多角体进行校正训练,在提供时遵守精细的几何限制,同时在粗细的代用物下合成合理的局部运动,从而能够对输入细节进行运行时间选择。 为了搭接双向创建和实时流线,而无需复合步压和出行漂移,我们引入了进取推进(Processing). 利用从培训录像中得出的历史,先对因果预测器进行检测,再将其分解成四步渲染器。 然后,培训转向持续自发推出。 管道式服务堆栈支持高效的流线推论. 实验显示对代理家庭、颗粒物和相机路径的多功能控制,与最近的流线基线相比不断提高,以及稳定地30分钟的赛跑,以保持场景和标的外观。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Interactive video world models must synthesize coherent observations as user actions alter the environment [ 2 , 52 , 70 , 51 ] . Rather than simulating both dynamics and appearance in one network, an emerging paradigm maintains explicit state in an upstream engine and delegates visual synthesis to a generative renderer [ 8 , 20 , 56 ] . Visual and geometric proxies bridge the two stages by prescribing camera paths, layout, and entity motion while leaving photorealistic appearance to the video model [ 27 , 41 , 7 , 26 ] . Recent systems pair such structural cues with appearance references for offline authoring and real-time rendering [ 12 , 34 , 31 , 19 , 67 ] .
blocks.zh: 互动视频世界模型必须综合一致的观测,因为用户的行动改变了环境[2、52、70、51]。 新兴的范式不是模拟一个网络中的动态和外观,而是在上游引擎中保持明确状态,将视觉合成委托给基因转化器[8,20,56]. 视觉和几何代号通过规定相机路径、布局和实体运动来连接两个阶段,同时将相机现实化的外观留给视频模型[27,41,7,26]. 最近的系统将这种结构提示与外观参考相配合,用于离线编写和实时渲染[12、34、31、19、67]。

blocks.en: In practice, the structural detail appropriate for conditioning depends on the interaction. Broad navigation often requires only coarse scene geometry and root trajectories, whereas close-range interactions demand articulated poses or finer surface structure. Detailed proxies supply tighter constraints at higher construction and transmission cost, while coarse proxies are lightweight to produce yet leave local geometry and motion under-specified. A capable renderer must interpret both regimes faithfully. For example, a rigid mannequin that tracks a character’s root pose should constrain global position and heading without imposing a frozen limb posture on the generated motion.
blocks.zh: 在实践中,适合调节的结构细节取决于相互作用. 广义的通航往往只需要粗糙的场景几何和根轨迹,而近距离相互作用需求则清晰地表达出外形或更细细的地表结构. 详细的代用物以较高的建造和传输成本提供更严格的限制,而粗的代用物则轻而易举地生产,但留下了局部几何和运动的分量不足. 一个有能力的制造者必须忠实地解释这两个制度。 例如,追踪角色根部姿势的僵硬人造人应限制全球位置和行走,而不对产生的运动施加被冻结的四肢姿势。

blocks.en: We introduce Invoker-Render , a proxy-conditioned rendering framework comprising a bidirectional creation model and a causal four-step streaming model . Both accept structural proxies, an appearance reference, and language through a shared interface. Training covers different proxy families, such as semantic layouts and shaded geometry, and multiple granularities within a family. Each checkpoint can follow fine constraints when supplied and synthesize plausible local motion when omitted, supporting different input granularities with the same weights.
blocks.zh: 我们引入Invoker-Render, 由双向创建模型和因果四相流模型组成的代理条件渲染框架。 两者都通过共享接口接受结构代用,外观参考,语言. 培训涵盖不同的代理家庭,如语义布局和阴影几何等,以及一个家庭内的多颗粒. 每一个检查站在提供时都能够遵守精细的限制,在省略时可以合成合理的局部运动,支持重量相同的不同输入颗粒.

blocks.en: For video creation, users edit complete proxy sequences to refine camera paths, trajectories, and event timing. The bidirectional model attends across the full clip. During streaming, future states depend on actions yet to occur. The causal model therefore consumes proxy chunks and local text incrementally, generating each chunk in four steps using retained visual history.
blocks.zh: 对于视频的创建,用户会编辑完整的代理序列来完善相机路径,轨迹,以及事件时间. 双向型号通过整段片段出席. 在流出期间,未来国家取决于尚未采取的行动。 因此,因果模型会逐渐消耗代理块和本地文本,利用所保留的视觉历史分四个步骤生成每个块.

blocks.en: We build on MiniMax-H3 [ 42 ] and adopt Guidance-Free Training (GFT) [ 6 ] to adapt its guidance-distilled backbone to proxy conditioning. Converting the resulting bidirectional model to a streaming renderer requires both fewer denoising steps and tolerance to errors in generated history. Progressive Forcing (ProForcing) addresses these changes in stages (Figure 4 ). Teacher forcing (TF) first trains block-causal prediction on clean video prefixes. Resampling forcing (RF) then constructs imperfect histories by adding noise to observed prefixes and refining them sequentially with the current model.
blocks.zh: 我们利用MiniMax-H3[42],并采用无指导培训[6],以调整其被制取的导推干线以适应代理条件。 将由此产生的双向模型转换为流化渲染器,既需要较少的去诺步骤,也需要对生成的历史错误的容忍. 渐进强制(Profile)在阶段中解决了这些变化(图4.). 教师强迫 (TF) 首列列车在清洁视频前缀上进行区块-原因预测. 然后通过在观测到的前缀中添加噪音,并用目前的模型相继地对其进行精炼来构建不完美的历史.

blocks.en: RF-DMD retains these resampled histories while learning four-step generation through distribution matching distillation (DMD) [ 64 , 63 ] and an auxiliary GAN loss [ 23 ] . The student, trainable score model, and GAN discriminator then continue training on continuous self-generated histories in SF-DMD [ 18 , 61 , 14 ] . Long-rollout training thus starts with a four-step generator and supervision models already trained alongside it.
blocks.zh: RF-DMD保留了这些被复制的历史,同时通过分布相匹配蒸馏(DMD)[64,63]和辅助GAN损失[23]来学习四步生成. 学生,可训练分数模型,以及GAN歧视者随后继续在SF-DMD[18,61,14]中进行关于连续自生历史的培训. 因此,长期推广培训从四步发电机和已经培训的监督模型入手。

blocks.en: We train on an aligned ∼ \sim 200-hour multi-granularity corpus with hierarchical text. Persistent history caching and pipelined proxy encoding and video decoding reduce serving overhead. Across 140 streaming rollouts, Invoker-Render outperforms recent streaming baselines in visual quality, structural adherence, and reference preservation, and maintains stable scene and subject appearance across 30-minute racing rollouts.
blocks.zh: 我们用一个200小时的 分级文本来训练 持续的历史缓存和管道代理编码和视频解码减少了服务费。 Invoker-Render在140个流出中,在视觉质量、结构坚持性和参考保护方面超越了最近的流出基线,并在30分钟的赛跑中保持稳定的场景和主题外观。

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • Mixed-granularity proxy conditioning. A shared conditioning interface lets each creation or streaming checkpoint accept coarse and fine proxies. • Progressive Forcing. A curriculum progresses from TF/RF causal adaptation to four-step DMD with GAN supervision, then continues the trained student, score model, and discriminator under self-generated histories. • Long-horizon controllable generation. Our four-step causal renderer outperforms recent streaming baselines and maintains scene and subject appearance across 30-minute racing rollouts. • Multi-granularity corpus and serving stack. An aligned ∼ \sim 200-hour dataset and a low-latency distributed serving engine support multi-granularity training and continuous interactive streaming.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是: 一个共享的调节接口让每个创建或流出检查点接受粗糙而精细的代理. • 逐步加强。 课程从TF/RF因果调整到GAN监督下的四步DMD,然后在自生自长的历史中延续训练有素的学生,分数模型,以及歧视者. • 长相可控发电。 我们的四步因果渲染器 超越了最近的流线基线 并保持场景和主题亮相 通过30分钟的赛跑推出。 · 多角度性和服务堆栈。 一个对齐的\ sim 200-小时数据集和一个低纬度分布式服务引擎支持多相干性培训和连续交互流.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Interactive Worlds and Generative Rendering
blocks.zh: 2.1 互动世界和基因生成

blocks.en: Action-conditioned video models often internalize world dynamics and visual synthesis in one network, learning latent or discrete action transitions from gameplay and video corpora [ 2 , 52 , 10 , 4 , 54 , 57 , 70 , 40 ] . LingBot-Video studies mixture-of-experts video pretraining for embodied intelligence, combining web videos with robot-oriented footage [ 39 ] . Streaming architectures extend interactive horizons across open-world interactions and explicit context or 3D-aware memory, including the Matrix-Game series, WorldPlay, WorldCrafter, and related streaming world models [ 16 , 53 , 44 , 68 , 51 , 66 , 46 , 13 , 62 ] . Because one visual transition model governs both state evolution and rendering, modifying scene structure or enforcing persistent physical rules remains challenging.
blocks.zh: 具备行动条件的视频模型往往将世界动态和视觉合成内化于一个网络,从游戏游戏和视频公司学习潜在的或离散的动作过渡[2,52,10,4,54,57,70,40]. 灵灵 Bot-Video研究混合专家视频预训以体现智能,将网络视频与面向机器人的镜头相结合[39]. 流体结构通过开放世界互动和明确上下文或3D-意识记忆,包括Matrix-Game系列,WorldPlay,WorldCrafter,以及相关的流体世界模型[16,53,44,68,51,66,46,13,62]. 由于一个视觉过渡模型既支配了状态演化又支配了渲染,所以修改场景结构或执行持续物理规则仍然是有挑战性的.

blocks.en: A complementary paradigm maintains explicit state in an executable engine or agentic controller and delegates synthesis to a conditioned video model. Code World Model, Programmable World Model, and AgentGarten compile structured program state into visual signals [ 8 , 20 , 9 ] , Marionette decouples state prediction, geometry rendering, and appearance painting [ 41 ] , and Wizard supports real-time world manipulation via agentic control [ 55 ] . StreamRender-H3, Streaming CWM, Magpie, and BoxWorld likewise couple game or simulator backends with neural renderers through semantic, white-box, or bounding-box streams [ 34 , 28 , 67 , 56 ] . Treating proxies as an explicit state-to-renderer contract, Invoker-Render studies controllable granularity across creation and streaming.
blocks.zh: 一个互补的范式在可执行的引擎或代理控制器中保持了明确的状态,并将合成分解为有条件的视频模型. 代码世界模型(Code World Model),可编程世界模型(AgentGarten)将结构化的程序状态编译为视觉信号[8,20,9],Marionette decouples state 预测,几何渲染,和外观画[41],"巫师"通过代理控制支持实时世界操纵[55]. blocks.en: 2.2 Proxy-Conditioned Video Generation
blocks.zh: 2.2 附加条件 视频生成

blocks.en: Building on spatial control, camera conditioning, and unified video creation frameworks [ 69 , 15 , 22 ] , proxy-conditioned video models ground synthesis in geometric or semantic structure across several regimes. Paired methods learn directly from dense geometry, lighting, material buffers, or animated meshes, as in DiffusionRenderer, Generative World Renderer, and native 4D mesh rendering [ 26 , 21 , 7 ] . Proxy2World relaxes paired supervision via posed RGB-D clips [ 59 ] , whereas training-free methods such as Code Video Model restrict proxy injection to early denoising steps so appearance follows the reference image [ 27 ] .
blocks.zh: 以空间控制,相机配置,和统一的视频创建框架[69,15,22]为基础,代用有条件的视频模型地面合成在几何结构或语义结构中跨越多个系统. 发酵法直接从密集的几何,照明,材料缓冲或动画中学习出,如"发酵放送"(DiffusionRender, Generative World Render)和原生的4D mesh渲染[26,21,7]. 代理服务器2 世界通过所展示的RGB-D片段放松了配对监督[59],而代码视频模型等无培训方法则将代理注射限制在早期去名步骤,因此外观遵循了参考图像[27].

blocks.en: Recent renderers broaden representation diversity, customization, and structural fidelity. SolarRenderer reuses the backbone’s reference pathway across heterogeneous structural videos with a four-step acceleration LoRA [ 12 ] , EdenLive and Mundo support real-time reference-driven rendering and customized world synthesis [ 19 , 36 ] , Fight World Model controls combat interactions via visual proxies [ 25 ] , and AnyGameRenderer preserves cross-game entity counts and timing [ 31 ] . Invoker-Render targets an orthogonal axis: structural granularity within one representation family, enabling a single model to honor fine constraints when supplied and synthesize natural local motion under lightweight coarse proxies.
blocks.zh: 最近制作者扩大了代表性的多样性、定制性和结构忠诚性。 SolarRenderer通过四步加速LORA[12],EdenLive和Mundo支持实时参考驱动渲染和定制世界合成[19,36],Fight World Model通过视觉代理控制战斗互动[25],AnyGameRenderer保留了交叉游戏实体计数和计时[31]. Invoker-Render瞄准正交轴:一个代表家族内部的结构颗粒性,使单一模型能够在提供并合成轻量级粗体代用下自然局部运动时能遵守精细的制约.

blocks.en: While training-free queue scheduling such as FIFO-Diffusion enables continuous generation via diagonal denoising [ 24 ] , interactive streaming requires block-causal attention and few-step sampling. blocks.en: To compress flow-matching trajectories [ 30 , 32 ] , consistency distillation maps states directly to clean targets [ 49 ] , score-based distribution matching [ 35 , 64 , 75 ] aligns distributions via auxiliary score differences, and DMD2, ADD, and LADD pair score or diffusion distillation with discriminator supervision [ 63 , 48 , 47 ] . Multi-step variants refine supervision across steps, with Trajectory Distribution Matching (TDM) and VA-TDM aligning multi-step trajectories and velocity fields [ 37 , 38 ] and Endpoint Distribution Matching (eDMD) anchoring the fake score model on final clean outputs [ 73 ] . For causal video, Causal Forcing uses an autoregressive ODE teacher, Causal Forcing++ and Causal-rCM adopt consistency-based causal initialization [ 78 , 72 , 74 ] , and Salt++ aligns streaming generation and scoring contexts [ 14 ] . ProForcing instead distills a four-step student with teacher-feature relativistic GAN supervision [ 23 , 47 ] on resampled data-anchored histories (RF-DMD) before continuing the coupled student, fake score model, discriminator, and optimizer states on continuous self-generated rollouts (SF-DMD).

blocks.en: 3 Data Curation and Proxy Construction
blocks.zh: 3 数据校正和代理构建

blocks.en: Controllable rendering requires aligned training pairs that cleanly separate the geometry prescribed by a proxy from the appearance and local dynamics synthesized by the model. Our corpus comprises approximately 200 hours of footage, combining 150 hours of self-collected data with 50 hours from public datasets, and associates each usable RGB clip with structural conditions, an appearance reference, and hierarchical text annotations. We design the pipeline around three core requirements: spatial-temporal correspondence between proxies and RGB targets, multi-granularity structural representations of the same event, and language descriptions tailored to both whole-window creation and block-causal streaming.
blocks.zh: 可控渲染需要对齐的训练配对,将代用方规定的几何与外观和模型所合成的局部动态清洁地分离. 我们的档案包括大约200小时的录像,将150小时的自收集数据与50小时的公共数据集合并,并将每个可用的RGB剪辑与结构条件、外观参考和分级文字说明联系起来。 我们围绕三个核心要求来设计管道:代理和RGB目标之间的空间-时态对应,同一事件的多角结构表现,以及针对全窗口创建和块-caus流的语言描述.

blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 数据来源和覆盖范围

blocks.en: Table 1 summarizes the corpus composition. Self-collected recordings allow us to render matched coarse and fine proxies from a shared reconstructed scene state, whereas public datasets broaden environment diversity and contribute native structural modalities. (a) Public datasets pair RGB frames with Magpie white-box geometry, CARLA depth, OmniWorld-Game depth, and Virtual KITTI 2 semantic layouts [ 67 , 11 , 76 , 3 ] . (b) Self-collected GTA V and Cyberpunk 2077 examples pair each RGB source frame with matched coarse and fine proxies of the same event, where coarse proxies place canonical root-driven bodies and fine proxies track articulated limbs.

blocks.en: We capture gameplay across diverse 3D environments (including Grand Theft Auto V, Cyberpunk 2077, Elden Ring, and Forza Horizon 5), spanning navigation, urban driving, and character interactions under varied camera trajectories, weather, and illumination. Automated navigation and driving scripts yield sustained, smooth trajectories, while human gameplay contributes unscripted interactions and rapid viewpoint transitions. RGB frames and accessible engine buffers are recorded synchronously, with camera poses and dynamic object states recovered offline where engine exports are incomplete, preserving continuous multi-action trajectories for long-horizon training.
blocks.zh: 我们捕捉跨越不同3D环境的游戏游戏(包括Grand Theft Auto V, Cyberpunk 2077,Elden Ring,和Forza Horizon 5),在各种相机轨迹,天气,和发光下横跨导航,城市驾驶和人物互动. 自动导航和驱动脚本产生持续平稳的轨迹,而人类游戏游戏则贡献了无标本的交互和快速的视角过渡. RGB帧和可访问的引擎缓冲器同步被记录,在引擎输出不完整的地方相机姿态和动态对象状态恢复下线,为长视距训练保留了连续多动作轨迹.

blocks.en: Public subsets contribute white-box geometry, semantic layouts, and dense depth, and Figure 2 additionally includes Virtual KITTI 2 [ 3 ] to illustrate RGB paired with dense semantic segmentation. Source-specific preprocessing aligns native annotations to a unified frame rate and conditioning interface, applying geometric and temporal validity checks before enabling structural supervision. Clips lacking reliable structural alignment are retained solely for reference-and-text appearance supervision. Recording available condition types per sample allows public datasets to contribute their native modalities without requiring synthetic coarse/fine pairs for every source.
blocks.zh: 公共子集贡献出白盒几何,语义布局,和密度深度,而图2还包含Virtual KITTI 2 [3],以说明RGB与密度语义分化的对接. 源特异性预处理将本地说明与统一的帧率和调制接口相协调,在允许结构监督之前应用几何和时间有效性检查. 缺乏可靠结构对齐的剪贴板仅保留用于参考和文字外观监督。 记录每个样本的现有条件类型,使公共数据集能够贡献其本土模式,而不需要合成粗细/细细配对的每个来源.

blocks.en: 3.2 Aligned Scene States and Multi-Granularity Proxies
blocks.zh: 3.2 相接的场地国与多地相近

blocks.en: Figure 3 outlines capture and proxy construction for our self-collected corpus. While recorded RGB serves as the supervision target, synchronized engine buffers and reconstructed 3D scene states (comprising camera intrinsics and extrinsics, static environment geometry, and tracked dynamic entities) allow us to render multiple structural granularities of the exact same visual event.
blocks.zh: 图3概述了我们自我收集的档案的捕捉和代理结构。 虽然被录制的RGB作为监督目标,同步引擎缓冲并重建了3D场景状态(由相机内在和外相,静态环境几何,跟踪动态实体等组成),使我们能够制作出完全相同的视觉事件的多个结构颗粒.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Capture and multi-granularity proxy construction pipeline. Synchronized gameplay capture and 3D scene reconstruction yield aligned appearance targets, geometry, entity dynamics, metadata, and text annotations. From a shared scene state, the pipeline renders matched coarse and fine structural proxies for each event.
blocks.zh: 图3: 捕获和多角性代理建筑管道。 同步的游戏玩法捕捉和3D场景重建产生对齐的外观目标,几何,实体动态,元数据,和文本说明. 从一个共享的场景状态,管道为每个事件提供相匹配的粗细结构代词.

blocks.en: Starting from synchronized RGB and engine depth capture, our reconstruction pipeline recovers camera calibration, scene semantics, and 3D entity motion. Instance segmentation and multi-object tracking [ 45 ] isolate moving actors and vehicles from the static scene, which is labeled via semantic segmentation and completed across invalid depth regions [ 60 ] , while camera pose estimation and background point tracking recover globally consistent trajectories. For dynamic actors, human motion recovery estimates both global root trajectories and articulated body poses, and 3D bounding-box fitting tracks rigid vehicle motion. Retaining per-frame camera parameters, track IDs, and confidence masks alongside the video enables automated reprojection and tracking verification prior to proxy rendering.
blocks.zh: 从同步RGB和引擎深度捕获开始,我们的重建管道恢复相机校正,场景语义,和3D实体运动. 实例分解和多对象跟踪[45] 将移动的演员和车辆从静态场景中隔离出,该场景通过语义分解来标注,并跨越无效深度区域完成 [60] 相机提出估计和背景点跟踪恢复全球一致的轨迹. 对于动态演员来说,人类运动恢复估计全球根道和被拼接的躯体,以及3D相接相接轨迹的刚性车辆运动. 保留每帧相机参数、跟踪ID和置信口罩与视频一起,可以在代理渲染前自动进行再预测和跟踪核查。

blocks.en: Coarse proxies encode global scene layout, camera motion, and entity placement and heading while omitting fine local geometry. Humans are rendered as canonical rigid mannequins driven solely by root pose, vehicles as oriented 3D boxes, and backgrounds as simplified geometry or semantic regions. Because a canonical mannequin conveys root translation and orientation without limb articulation, the paired RGB target and action text teach the generator to synthesize natural gait and posture consistent with the trajectory.
blocks.zh: 粗糙的代理编码了全局场景布局,相机运动,以及实体放置和取向,同时省略了精细的局部几何. 人类作为单由根状活性能驱动的犬形刚性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性活性 由于犬形活体能传递根的翻译和取向而无需四肢相通,相配的RGB目标和动作文本会教给生成者合成出与轨迹相通的自然行走和姿态.

blocks.en: Fine proxies augment this representation with articulated human poses (rendered as depth-tested volumetric body parts) and shaded local surface geometry, while preserving rigid vehicle boxes. Wherever both variants are constructed, coarse and fine proxies share identical camera parameters, timestamps, entity identities, and RGB targets, directly supervising the renderer across constraint strengths for the same event. Throughout this work, we distinguish granularity , meaning the level of geometric and kinematic detail within a representation, from representation family , such as semantic maps, shaded depth, or white-box renders.
blocks.zh: 精细的代用物增加了这种代表物的清晰人相(作为深度测试的体积部分)和阴影地表几何,同时保留了刚性车辆箱. 在构建两种变体的地方,粗糙和精细的代词共享相同的相机参数,时间戳,实体身份,以及RGB目标,直接监督渲染器跨越同一事件的制约优势. 在这项工作中,我们区分出颗粒性(grantularity), 指代表物中的几何和动能细节的水平, 与代表物家族, 如语义地图, 阴影深度, 或白盒所制作。

blocks.en: To prevent appearance leakage, both granularities strip away surface textures, materials, and scene lighting. Before compositing dynamic entities, foreground masks are excised from background depth and semantic buffers and inpainted from temporally adjacent background views, suppressing silhouette cues from clothing, hair, or accessories. Reprojecting the simplified dynamic primitives onto this cleaned background with depth occlusion ensures that proxies convey pure spatial and motion structure, leaving appearance to the reference frame, language, and learned video prior.
blocks.zh: 为防止外观被泄露,颗粒会剥去地表纹理,材料和场景照明. 在堆肥活性实体之前,前地口罩会从背景深度和语义缓冲处被切除出并被从时间相邻的背景视图中被涂入,压制从服装,发型,或附件中被分解出出出出来来来来. 将简化的活性原始物重新投影到这个有深度隐蔽的被清理的背景上,可以确保代词传递纯空间和运动结构,使外观留给参考框架,语言,以及学习到的视频先行.

blocks.en: 3.3 Sequence Lengths and Hierarchical Language
blocks.zh: 3.3 序列长度和等级语言

blocks.en: Self-collected and public recordings are standardized at 24 fps into 158-frame windows ( ∼ \sim 6.6 s) and 328-frame continuous sequences ( ∼ \sim 13.7 s). RGB targets use 1344 × 768 1344\times 768 , while aligned proxies are stored at 672 × 384 672\times 384 and encoded at 672 × 384 672\times 384 or 448 × 256 448\times 256 using nearest-neighbor resizing for semantic maps and anti-aliased filtering for continuous geometry. Short windows support bidirectional GFT, supervised TF/RF, and RF-DMD, whereas 328-frame sequences support variable-length SF-DMD rollouts across uninterrupted trajectories.
blocks.zh: 自收自收和公用录音在24 fps被标准化为158-帧窗口(∼\sim 6.6 s)和328-帧连续序列(∼\sim 13.7 s). RGB目标使用1344×768 1344\times 768;而对接的代号被存储于672×384 672\times 384,并被编码为672×384 672\times 384或448×256,使用近邻重排大小用于语义图和抗异名过滤用于连续几何. 短窗支持双向GFT,受监督的TF/RF和RF-DMD,而328帧序列则支持可变长的SF-DMD在不间断轨迹上展开.

blocks.en: Text annotations combine clip-level scene descriptions with timestamped local actions (“Scene + local actions” in Figure 3 ). Each window pairs its opening RGB anchor with a vision-language caption covering environment, subject appearance, lighting, events, and camera motion. The bidirectional creation model and the bidirectional teacher and fake score models each receive independent whole-window captions rather than concatenated local tags.
blocks.zh: 文字说明结合了剪贴级场景描述和被打上时间戳的局部动作(“场景+局部动作”在图3中). 每个窗口对开的RGB主播配有视觉语言字幕,涵盖环境,主题外观,照明,事件和相机运动等. 双向创建模式和双向老师和假分分模型各获得独立的全窗字幕,而不会获得相容的本地标签.

blocks.en: Timestamped local annotations track action progression, motion directions, interactions, and camera shifts across block boundaries so that TF/RF and the distilled student observe text strictly up to the current block, without future labels or clip summaries. For coarse proxies, local text disambiguates behaviors whose articulation is omitted from rigid root geometry.
blocks.zh: 时间标出本地注释 跟踪动作进展,运动方向,相互作用,相机跨块边界移动,使TF/RF和被蒸馏的学生严格地观察到当前块的文字,没有未来的标签或剪辑摘要. 对于粗糙的代名词,本地文本将那些被从刚性根几何中省去的表述的行为分解.

blocks.en: A system instruction defines the roles of structural proxies and the appearance reference alongside sample captions, while automated validation checks reference tags, temporal order, and entity-action agreement.
blocks.zh: 系统指令定义了结构代理和外观参考与样本标题的作用,而自动化验证检查参考标记,时间顺序,以及实体-行动协议.

blocks.en: 3.4 Quality Control and Evaluation Separation
blocks.zh: 3.4 质量控制和评价

blocks.en: Quality control screens both video and proxies for corrupted or frozen frames, exposure failures, shot cuts, reprojection outliers, tracking switches, and timing drift. Automated geometric checks and manual review evaluate each proxy against its intended constraints, distinguishing omitted coarse articulation from root-trajectory or camera errors.
blocks.zh: 质量控制屏蔽视频和代理显示损坏或被冻结的相框、曝光失败、镜头切片、再投影输出器、跟踪开关和计时漂移。 自动几何检查和人工审查根据每种代用方法的预期限制对每种代用方法进行评价,将粗略地表达与根-弹出或相机错误区分开来。

blocks.en: Records track source identifiers, frame ranges, proxy variants, captions, and encoding provenance, with cross-source deduplication across shared game worlds. Training and held-out splits are partitioned by recording (and by scene or map where identifiable), keeping overlapping windows, coarse/fine pairs, and alternative views of one recording in the same split to prevent leakage.
blocks.zh: 记录跟踪源标识符,帧范围,代理变体,标题,和编码出处,跨共享游戏世界的跨源分解. 培训和被搁置的分拆通过录音(以及可识别的场景或地图)进行分拆,保持相重叠的窗口,粗糙/精细的对接,以及在同一分拆中进行一个分拆的另类取景,以防止渗出.

blocks.en: 4 Invoker-Render
blocks.zh: 4 投影仪

blocks.en: Invoker-Render adapts MiniMax-H3 [ 42 ] into both a bidirectional video creation model and a causal four-step streaming renderer. We first formalize the shared conditioning interface and linear flow parameterization, then present bidirectional proxy adaptation via Guidance-Free Training, and finally detail Progressive Forcing (ProForcing), which distills few-step causal rendering on data-anchored histories before transitioning to continuous self-generated rollouts.
blocks.zh: Invoker-Render将MiniMax-H3[42]既改编为双向视频创建模型,又改编为因果四相流渲染器. 我们首先将共享调节接口和线性流参数化正式化,然后通过"指导-Free"(Fuide-Free Training)演示出双向代理适应,最后详细介绍"进步强制"(Proforcing),在向连续自发推出过渡之前,在数据焦虑的历史上提炼出几步的因果渲染.

blocks.en: Coarse and fine proxies enter through an identical conditioning pathway, trained jointly on mixed-granularity examples. Coarse inputs prescribe scene layout, camera trajectory, and entity root motion, while fine inputs further constrain limb articulation and local surface geometry. At inference time, downstream applications can select the structural detail suited to each interaction while relying on the appearance reference, text, and video prior to supply visual texture and unconstrained local motion.

blocks.en: Directly distilling a bidirectional model into a few-step autoregressive renderer conflates trajectory compression with exposure to self-generated rollout errors. ProForcing disentangles these challenges across progressive stages (Figure 4 ). Supervised TF and RF first adapt attention to block-causal histories anchored to ground-truth video, RF-DMD then distills a four-step generator alongside learned score and adversarial critics under those data-anchored histories, and SF-DMD (Section 4.4 ) finally transitions the jointly trained system to continuous self-generated rollouts.

blocks.en: Building on self-forcing and streaming long tuning [ 18 , 61 ] , SF-DMD replaces data-anchored RF prefixes with continuous student-generated histories. Starting from the appearance anchor a a , the student sequentially denoises each block in four steps and commits its detached terminal prediction 𝒙 ^ 0 b \widehat{\bm{x}}_{0}^{b} to the causal history cache ( 𝒉 SF b = 𝒙 ^ 0 < b \bm{h}_{\mathrm{SF}}^{b}=\widehat{\bm{x}}_{0}^{<b} ). While detached terminal outputs advance the rollout state, selected step predictions 𝒙 0 θ \bm{x}_{0}^{\theta} retain local computation graphs for DMD and GAN supervision. Student weights remain fixed throughout the multi-block rollout, accumulate gradients across scored intervals, and take a single consolidated update before the next rollout refreshes its history from scratch.

blocks.en: To supervise rollouts longer than the bidirectional teacher’s native window, we tile the continuous student stream with overlapping local scoring windows. Each window pairs preceding generated blocks (serving purely as detached temporal context) with a disjoint interval of newly generated target blocks, always retaining the original appearance anchor a a . The teacher, fake score model, and discriminator observe complete conditions within each local window while the student remains causal, and DMD and GAN input gradients are masked to apply strictly once per non-anchor target block, weighted by target coverage.

blocks.en: Crucially, transitioning from RF-DMD to SF-DMD carries forward the entire coupled training state (student weights, fake score model 𝒇 fake \bm{f}_{\mathrm{fake}} , discriminator D ϕ D_{\phi} , their respective AdamW moments [ 33 ] , and the student EMA) against the same frozen teacher. Because RF-DMD already converges a capable four-step causal generator together with calibrated supervision models tailored to its output distribution, SF-DMD avoids cold-start critic instability and focuses optimization on mitigating long-horizon error accumulation under self-generated histories.

blocks.en: 5 Streaming Serving Infrastructure
blocks.zh: 5 简化服务基础设施

blocks.en:
To deploy the causal world model as an online interactive rendering service, each streaming step must encode incoming visual proxies, update retained clean history H H and current proxy conditioning C C within a bounded KV window, run four-step causal denoising, and return decoded RGB frames within a strict latency budget.
Starting from a standard streaming baseline, we streamline the inference stack across three levels:
(i) an asymmetric streaming codec pairing a lightweight Tiny AutoEncoder (TAE) for online proxy encoding with a causal video decoder for RGB reconstruction;
(ii) intra-window invariant reuse and fused execution across DiT layers, KV workspaces, and prefill/denoising passes; and
(iii) cross-packet codec overlap and asynchronous CPU delivery (Figure 5 ).
On an eight-GPU node at 1344 × 768 1344\times 768 resolution, these optimizations reduce the steady-state per-chunk period from 1770 ms to 930 ms and increase throughput from 9.9 FPS to 18.0 FPS ( 1.82 × \times speedup; Figure 6 ).

blocks.en: 5.1 Efficient Asymmetric Streaming Codec
blocks.zh: 5.1 高效的不对称 流出代码c

blocks.en:
Interactive streaming places asymmetric demands on the visual codec: incoming proxy frames must be encoded at every chunk with minimal latency, whereas generated latents must be decoded into temporally continuous RGB video.
Encoding online proxies with the full video encoder is slower than output decoding and dominates the inter-chunk codec interval.
blocks.zh:
交互流出地对视觉编码器的非对称要求: 接入的代理帧必须在每一个块上进行编码,而生成的潜入必须解码为时间上连续的RGB视频.
带完整视频编码器的编码在线代理比输出解码慢,并主导了相通相通的编码间隔.

blocks.en:
We therefore adopt an asymmetric codec design.
The static reference frame is encoded once at session start with the full encoder to preserve anchor detail, while online proxy packets are encoded independently by a lightweight TAE proxy encoder directly into normalized 16 × 16\times spatially compressed, 24-channel conditioning latents.
On the output side, we retain the tensor-parallel Causal Video Decoder to preserve temporal continuity across chunks.
Replacing the online proxy encoder with TAE makes input encoding an order of magnitude faster than causal decoding ( T enc ≪ T dec T_{\mathrm{enc}}\ll T_{\mathrm{dec}} ), reducing the steady-state chunk period from 1770 ms to 1410 ms and raising throughput from 9.9 FPS to 12.4 FPS .
blocks.zh:
因此,我们采用了不对称的编码设计。
静态参考框架在会话开始时一次被编码为完整编码器来保存锚地细节,而在线代理包则由轻量级的TAE代理编码器独立地被编码为正态化的16×16正时空间压缩,24道调节潜伏.
在输出方面,我们保留了高温平行的 Causal 视频解码器,以保持跨块的时间连续性.
用TAE来取代在线代理编码器,使输入编码比因果解码快(T enc QQ T Dec T_{\mathrm{enc}}\ll T_{\mathrm{dec}}}),将稳态块期从1770ms缩短到1410ms,将吞吐量从9.9 FPS提升到12.4 FPS.

blocks.en: 5.2 Intra-Window Reuse and Fused Execution
blocks.zh: 5.2 温道内部重复使用和引信执行

blocks.en: Within each DiT window, we eliminate redundant per-layer preparation, projection compute, memory allocation, and separate prefill launches:
blocks.zh: 在每个 DiT 窗口内,我们取消每个层的冗余准备,投影计算,内存分配以及单独的预填发射:

blocks.en:
• Cross-layer structural sharing. Within a single forward pass, all DiT layers share identical token layout plans, sliding-window crop indices, and frame-aligned RoPE position tensors.
We construct these plans and index tensors once at backbone entry and reuse them across all layers. • Per-layer AdaLN projection caching. Because session conditioning is stationary and the four-step Euler timestep schedule repeats across chunks, we cache each DiT block’s projected AdaLN modulation parameters by timestep and reuse them across subsequent chunks. • Transactional KV workspace reuse. Instead of allocating fresh output and concatenation buffers at every layer, we reuse pre-allocated KV result backplanes and temporary forward workspaces across the transaction lifecycle (Figure 5 , top).
Combining structural invariant and workspace reuse reduces the steady-state chunk period from 1410 ms to 1180 ms and lifts throughput from 12.4 FPS to 14.4 FPS . • Fused prefill-and-denoise pass ( H/C/D 1 \text{H/C/D}_{1} ). In ordinary continuation windows, we defer committing prior clean history H n − 1 H_{n-1} and pack it with incoming proxy tokens C n C_{n} and the first denoising state D 1 D_{1} into a single block-causal composite forward (Pass 1 in Figure 5 ), followed by three denoising-only passes ( D 2 D_{2} – D 4 D_{4} ).
Reducing backbone launches from six to four trims the chunk period from 1180 ms to 1165 ms and raises throughput to 14.8 FPS .

blocks.en: 5.3 Cross-Packet Pipelining and RGB Delivery
blocks.zh: 5.3 相套管和RGB交付

blocks.en: With intra-window DiT execution compressed, we pipeline codec execution and host frame delivery across packet boundaries to remove inter-chunk idle gaps:
blocks.zh: 随着窗口内部的 DiT 执行压缩, 我们管道代码执行和主机帧发送跨越包边界, 以去除空隙 :

blocks.en:
• Cross-packet codec overlap. Between consecutive DiT windows, causal video decoding for chunk n n and TAE proxy encoding for chunk n + 1 n{+}1 run concurrently on disjoint GPU subsets (Figure 5 , center and bottom).
Because TAE encoding finishes well within the causal decoding window, next-packet proxy encoding is hidden behind current-packet decoding. • Pipelined CPU delivery. Once causal decoding and the device-to-host copy into shared RGB memory complete, frame packing and socket emission are offloaded to an asynchronous CPU worker.
The GPU pool immediately starts chunk n + 1 n{+}1 ’s DiT passes while host delivery proceeds in parallel, cutting the steady-state chunk period from 1165 ms to 930 ms and reaching 18.0 FPS .

blocks.en: 6 Experiments
blocks.zh: 6个实验

blocks.en: We evaluate Invoker-Render through systematic pairwise preference comparisons on causal streaming rollouts alongside qualitative studies of multi-granularity creation, camera control, and long-horizon streaming. Section 6.1 details the held-out benchmark and evaluation protocol, Section 6.2 compares our four-step causal renderer against representative streaming baselines, and Section 6.3 illustrates control across proxy families, structural granularities, camera paths, and extended rollouts.
blocks.zh: 我们对Invoker-Render的评价是通过系统双向对因果流出进行偏好比较,同时对多角性产生、相机控制和长相流进行定性研究。 第6.1节详细说明了搁置的基准和评价协议,第6.2节比较了我们四个步骤的因果成像器与有代表性的流线基线,第6.3节说明了对代理家族的控制、结构颗粒、相机路径和扩展推出。

blocks.en: 6.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 6.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate causal streaming rendering on a held-out benchmark of 140 test sequences spanning 6.58 s to 20 s across diverse 3D environments, multi-entity interactions, and proxy representation families, covering both single-window clips and multi-window streaming rollouts. We compare our ProForcing-trained Invoker-Render (Causal, 4-step) checkpoint against three representative few-step causal and streaming proxy-conditioned renderers: SolarRenderer (Causal, 4-step) [ 12 ] , StreamRender-H3 (2-step) [ 34 ] , and Streaming CWM (4-step) [ 28 ] . Every method receives the identical structural proxy video and appearance reference image on each test sequence.
blocks.zh: 我们以140个测试序列为基准, 在不同的三维环境、多实体互动和代理代表家族之间, 对因果流表达进行评估, 包括单窗口剪辑和多窗口流出。 我们比较了我们经过训练的Invoker-Render(Causal,4-step)检查站与三个具有代表性的几步因果和流派代理条件的渲染器:SolarRender(Causal,4-step)[12],StreamRender-H3(2-step) [34],和流派CWM(4-step)[28]. 每种方法都得到每个测试序列上相同的结构代理视频和外观参考图像.

blocks.en: Effective streaming proxy rendering demands sharp per-frame synthesis, faithful spatial-temporal alignment to the driving proxy, and sustained reference fidelity across sliding windows. Following SolarRenderer [ 12 ] , we use Gemini 3.8 Flash to conduct blinded pairwise evaluations along four criteria. Each query presents the ground-truth structural proxy sequence, the appearance reference image, and two anonymized candidate renderings A A and B B (uniformly sampled as timestamped frame sequences at 672 × 384 672\times 384 and 12 fps with randomized order balancing), eliciting an independent win, tie, or loss judgment along four axes: • Visual Quality: per-frame detail sharpness, suppression of synthesis artifacts, and temporal smoothness. • Structure & Motion: adherence of scene geometry, subject trajectories, action timing, and camera motion to the input proxy. • Reference Preservation: stability of palette, illumination, material appearance, and subject identity relative to the reference frame. • Overall Preference: holistic quality as a coherent, deliverable rendered sequence. Pairwise preferences are summarized as Elo ratings using the Bradley–Terry model [ 1 ] , with ties counted as half a win and the mean rating across methods set to 1000. Overall Preference is evaluated independently of the three component criteria.
blocks.zh: 有效的流式代理渲染需要尖锐的每帧合成,忠实的空间-时态与驱动代理相匹配,并持续地在滑动窗口之间保持参考忠心. 使用双子座 3.8 Flash 进行双盲双相评价 每个查询都呈现出地-实结构代用序列,外观参考图像,以及两个匿名候选人渲染出A A和B(以672×384 672\times 384和12 fps为时间标定的帧序列被统一取样,并随机排列顺序平衡),沿四轴引出独立的胜负,平局,或损失判断: • 视觉质量:每帧细节尖锐,压制合成文物,以及时间平稳. • 结构与运动:场景几何、主题轨迹、动作时间和相机运动对输入代理的坚持。 • 参考保存:调色板的稳定性、发光、物质外观和与参考框架相对的主题身份。 • 总体偏好:整体质量是连贯、可交付的顺序。 平分偏好被归纳为使用布拉德利-特瑞模式[1]的Elo收视率,关系计为半赢,跨方法的平均收视率被设定为1000. 总体优先评价独立于三个组成部分标准。

blocks.en: • Proxy families and geometric granularity (Figure 9 ). Each row pairs two views of the same scene and event at a matched timestamp, using a shared appearance reference and different proxy-defined camera routes. Two racing sequences are compared at six matched timestamps each, extending to 298 s and 299 s. blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We presented Invoker-Render, a proxy-conditioned video rendering framework that unifies bidirectional video creation and four-step causal streaming under a shared multi-granularity interface. Built on a ∼ \sim 200-hour multi-granularity video-proxy corpus, Progressive Forcing decouples causal adaptation and four-step DMD and GAN distillation on data-anchored histories from stateful continuation on self-generated rollouts, mitigating long-horizon drift while preserving structural fidelity and reference identity. Co-designing this renderer with a fused, KV-persistent, and codec-pipelined serving stack enables low-latency chunked execution, yielding consistent gains in visual quality, structural tracking, and reference preservation across streaming evaluations and sustaining coherent 30-minute racing rollouts toward infinite controllable generation.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了Invoker-Render,一个代理条件的视频渲染框架,它统一了双向视频的创建和在共享多角度界面下的四步因果流. 建于相距200小时的多角相机视频-代用装置上,在数据预留历史上进行渐进式的DMD和GAN分解,从自生自灭的状态延续起,减轻了长相漂移,同时保持结构忠诚和参考身份。 用一个引信、KV-持久性和可编码管线式服务堆栈共同设计这个渲染器,可以实现低密度的块状执行,在视觉质量、结构跟踪和整个流式评价的参考保存方面产生持续收益,并保持连贯的30分钟赛跑向无限可控的生成。

blocks.en: Several directions remain open for scaling proxy-conditioned world rendering. First, although our static prefix sink and sliding KV window bound inference cost and sustain appearance over extended sessions, visual details outside the active window are eventually evicted once they leave the local context. Incorporating explicit long-term memory mechanisms directly into causal training and distillation, such as learnable memory compression, spatial-temporal context retrieval, or persistent 3D-aware state caches, would allow the renderer to recall previously visited environments and maintain multi-entity appearance consistency across revisits. Second, because current training uses a fixed proxy granularity within each rollout window, supporting dynamic mid-stream level-of-detail transitions and coupling Invoker-Render with interactive state engines in closed loop remain promising avenues for future work.
blocks.zh: 有几个方向仍然开放,以扩大代用条件的世界渲染。 首先,尽管我们的静态前缀槽和滑动的 KV 窗口在扩展会话中绑定推论成本并维持外观,但活动窗口外的视觉细节一旦离开本地环境,最终被移除. 将明确的长期内存机制直接纳入因果培训和分馏,如可学习的内存压缩,空间-时空上下文检索,或持续的3D-意识状态缓存等,将使渲染器能够回顾以前访问过的环境,并在整个再审中保持多实体外观的一致性. 第二,因为目前的训练在每个推出窗口内使用固定的代理颗粒,支持动态的中流层细节过渡并用闭环式互动状态引擎将Invoker-Render相接,仍然是未来工作的有希望的途径.
